Question 6
?

For the transformation f:R2→R2, defined as

f(x)=[x2y(x−y)2],x=[xy],

calculate f′(x).

a
[xyx2x−y−(x−y)]
b
[2xyx22(x−y)−2(x−y)]
c
[2xyx2y−2(x−y)2(x−y)]
d
[xy2x2(x−y)−2(x−y)]
e
[xy2xx−yy−x]
